description: Fiber 3 on fasthttp, default configuration bar prefork: one child per logical CPU sharing the port with SO_REUSEPORT and splitting the Postgres budget, at the cost of a Go runtime per child. Routing and typed path/query binding through the Fiber API, JSON via c.JSON, gzip and brotli through the Fiber compress middleware, static files read from disk per request and served from their pre-compressed .br/.gz twin.
